name: Two-Phase Traffic Light
requirement: Control traffic lights at a single junction. Phase A: North-South green (30s), then amber (5s). Phase B: East-West green (25s), then amber (5s). Both must never be green simultaneously.
safety_constraints: North-South and East-West green outputs must never be true at the same time.
Each green phase must transition through amber before red.
A deterministic safe startup phase must set both directions to red.

expected_properties.description: Mutual exclusion of NS_Green and EW_Green.
Amber intermediary phase is present for both directions.
